metadata.title: Hypervelocity stars from young stellar clusters in the Galactic Centre

notes: No eligible individually identifiable stars: the paper studies simulated populations of single and binary HVSs (e.g. T:p3-b18; T:p5-b2) rather than named stars with individual identifiers. The observed HVSs mentioned at T:p9-b19 are unnamed and cited only as context.
